title: Concave mirror, object beyond C
back: Image between F and C: real, inverted, diminished.

title: Total internal reflection
back: Denser → rarer and i > c. sin c = 1/n; glass c ≈ 42°, diamond ≈ 24°.

title: Convex lens, object beyond 2F
back: Image between F′ and 2F′: real, inverted, diminished.

title: Ray through a prism
back: r₁ + r₂ = A; i + e = A + δ; at minimum deviation i = e.

title: Compound microscope
back: Objective: real magnified image; eyepiece: magnifier. m = (L/f_o)(D/f_e).

title: Astronomical telescope
back: Normal adjustment: m = f_o/f_e, length f_o + f_e; final image inverted.

title: Cassegrain telescope
back: Concave primary, convex secondary, eyepiece behind a hole: no chromatic aberration, lighter.

title: Mirror formula
back: Concave f negative; convex f positive.

title: Lens maker’s formula
back: In a liquid of the same n the lens vanishes optically.

title: Critical angle
back: Used in optical fibres, reflecting prisms, diamonds, mirages.

title: Focal lengths: microscope vs telescope
back: "Microscope: chhota-chhota; Telescope: bada-chhota": microscope f_o < f_e (both short); telescope f_o ≫ f_e.
